items.title: Bioenergetics aur ATP: cells ki tawanai ki currency (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and the ATP section, printed pages 140-141.

blocks.text: Har jandar (organism), sab se chhote bacterium se le kar sab se bare whale tak, tawanai (energy) se chalta hai. Yeh tawanai numu (growth), afzaish (reproduction) aur rozana ki baqa (survival) ka eendhan hai, aur yun zindagi ka bunyadi pehlu. Yeh tawanai kahan se aati hai, aur cells ise zindagi ke liye zaroori be-shumar kaamon ke liye kaise hasil aur istemal karte hain? Jawab bioenergetics mein hai.

blocks.title: Bioenergetics
blocks.text: Bioenergetics is baat ka mutala hai ke tawanai zinda nizamon (systems) mein kaise behti hai. Yeh un amal ko parhti hai jin se cells tawanai zakheera (store) aur kharch karte hain. Photosynthesis aur tanaffus (respiration) is ke usool samjhate hain: photosynthesis tawanai pakarne wala amal hai aur tanaffus tawanai chhorne wala.

blocks.title: Taqreeban tamam tawanai kahan se aati hai
blocks.text: Zameen par jandaron ki istemal ki hui taqreeban tamam tawanai photosynthesis se aati hai. Poday, algae aur kuch bacteria sooraj ki roshni pakar kar use kemiyai (chemical) tawanai mein badalte hain, jo food chain ki bunyad banti hai.
ATP: cells ki tawanai ki currency

Cells apne reactions ke liye ek khaas tawanai ki currency istemal karte hain: ek nucleotide jise adenosine triphosphate (ATP) kehte hain. Jab cells tawanai zakheera karte hain to ATP banate hain; jab tawanai chahiye hoti hai to ATP torte hain. ATP ke molecule ke teen hisse hain: adenine (nitrogen wala base), ribose (paanch-carbon sugar) aur teen phosphate groups.

blocks.title: Daryaft
blocks.text: ATP 1929 mein Karl Lohmann ne daryaft kiya. 1941 mein Nobel inaam yafta Fritz Lipmann ne tajweez kiya ke ATP cell mein tawanai muntaqil karne wala bunyadi molecule hai.

Do phosphates ke darmiyan covalent bonds high-energy bonds hain. Jab in mein se ek bond toot-ta hai to inorganic phosphate (Pi) alag hota hai aur tawanai nikalti hai: ek phosphate bond ka tootna fi mole ATP taqreeban 7.3 kcal (7,300 calories) deta hai. Aam tawanai ke reactions mein sirf bahar wala P-P high-energy bond toot-ta hai; ATP ADP (adenosine diphosphate) ban jata hai aur ek Pi nikalta hai. Kuch sooraton mein ADP mazeed toot kar AMP (adenosine monophosphate) aur Pi banata hai, phir 7.3 kcal fi mole deta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: ATP molecule adenine, ribose ke pentagon aur teen phosphate dairon ke taur par, phosphates ke darmiyan surkh khameeda high-energy bonds. Daen: upar ATP aur neeche ADP + Pi ke darmiyan do teeron ka cycle, neeche jata teer pani ke saath tootna aur tawanai nikalna, upar jata teer khuraak ke oxidation ki tawanai se banna.
blocks.caption: ATP ki banawat aur ATP-ADP cycle (chapter ki Figures 5.1 aur 5.2 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: ATP adenine, ribose aur teen phosphates hai; phosphates ke darmiyan bonds high-energy bonds hain. Pani se bahar wala bond torne par ADP, inorganic phosphate aur taqreeban 7.3 kcal fi mole milti hai; ADP ek aur phosphate kho kar AMP ban sakta hai. Cells khuraak ke oxidation ki tawanai se ADP aur Pi jor kar ATP dobara banate hain, is liye ATP tawanai chhorne wale amal mein banta aur tawanai kharch karne wale amal mein toot-ta hai, aur metabolic reactions ke darmiyan tawanai le jata hai.

blocks.caption: Tootne ke do reactions
rows: ATP + H2O se ADP + Pi + tawanai
ADP + H2O se AMP + Pi + tawanai

blocks.text: Cells khuraak ke oxidation se tawanai lete hain. Woh yeh tawanai ADP ko Pi se jor kar ATP bana kar zakheera karte hain. To ATP tawanai chhorne wale amal ke dauran banta hai aur tawanai kharch karne wale amal ke dauran toot-ta hai; is tarah ATP metabolic reactions ke darmiyan tawanai muntaqil (transfer) karta hai.

blocks.prompt: ATP ko tawanai ka zakheera nahin balke currency kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Paise ki tarah ATP der tak rakha nahin jata balke ek amal se doosre tak guzarta hai: khuraak ke oxidation jaise tawanai chhorne wale reactions ADP aur Pi jor kar tawanai jama karte hain, aur tawanai kharch karne wale reactions high-energy phosphate bond tor kar use kharch karte hain. Yeh tawanai zakheera karne ki bajaye muntaqil karta hai.

items: Bioenergetics zinda nizamon mein tawanai ke bahao ka mutala hai; photosynthesis tawanai pakarti hai aur tanaffus chhorta hai. Zindagi ki taqreeban tamam tawanai photosynthesis se aati hai.
ATP (Lohmann 1929; Lipmann 1941) adenine + ribose + teen phosphates hai jin ke P-P bonds high-energy hain. ATP + H2O se ADP + Pi + 7.3 kcal fi mole; ADP aage AMP ban sakta hai.
ATP khuraak oxidise hone par banta hai (ADP + Pi) aur tawanai chahiye hone par toot-ta hai: cell ki tawanai ki currency.
